jobs.description_text:
Temus is a Temasek-backed consulting firm providing digital transformation solutions for the private and public sectors. We aspire to be a strategic partner in realising the Singapore Government’s Smart Nation vision. We are headquartered in Singapore and have more than 400 employees across a wide range of disciplines in strategy, design, architecture, technology, data & AI.

Your objectives

  • Lead the architecture and delivery of enterprise AI platforms and solutions, ensuring alignment with client business objectives, technology standards, and governance requirements.
  • Solve the hardest problems with AI to deliver social and economic value.
  • Build and lead a world-class AI team.
  • Develop and maintain relationships with a broad range of clients, colleagues, and partners across a variety of contexts and formats.
  • Inspire, mentor, and develop junior team members.
  • Maintain a culture of excellence and lead with confidence, charisma, context, and humility working effectively at all levels.
  • Create and deliver technical blogs & thought leadership on AI.
  • Invest continuously in building and extending your knowledge and skills.

Your background

  • Exceptional expertise in delivering AI engineering, machine learning and data science projects.
  • Experience architecting and delivering cloud-native AI and data platforms on AWS, Azure, or GCP, including infrastructure, platform, and application layers.
  • Experience leading cross-functional engineering teams comprising AI Engineers, Software Engineers, Data Engineers, DevOps Engineers, and Solution Architects.
  • Strong understanding of modern software architecture, cloud-native development, microservices, containerisation, Kubernetes, and CI/CD practices.
  • Experience delivering complex public sector or enterprise projects as a Technical Lead or Solution Architect will be a plus
  • Practical hands-on experience to assist in the AI development lifecycle.
  • Experience delivering and managing AI solutions through incubation, proofs-of-concept, to deployment and commercialization.
  • Strong ability to develop and maintain relationships amongst clients, colleagues, and partners.
  • Ability to develop and deliver client proposals, and build consensus supported by detailed analysis, deep expertise and effective communication.
  • Demonstrated ability to create technical blogs & thought leadership on AI.
  • Active engagement in the AI community taking and giving courses, following podcasts, reading books, attending meetups, and developing projects.

Temus is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from all. We do not discriminate by race, religion, belief, ethnicity, origin, disability, age, partnership status, sexual orientation, or gender identity.

We see the diversity of our team as a strategic advantage, and we work actively to maintain it.

jobs.description_text:
Temus is a Temasek-backed consulting firm providing digital transformation solutions for the private and public sectors. We aspire to be a strategic partner in realising the Singapore Government’s Smart Nation vision. We are headquartered in Singapore and have more than 400 employees across a wide range of disciplines in strategy, design, architecture, technology, data & AI.

Your Objectives

  • Solve the hardest problems with AI to deliver social and economic value.
  • Develop and maintain relationships with a broad range of clients, colleagues, and partners across a variety of contexts and formats.
  • Build, lead and mentor a world-class team of AI and data engineers.
  • Maintain a culture of excellence and lead with confidence, charisma, context, and humility working effectively at all levels.
  • Create and deliver technical blogs & thought leadership on AI.
  • Invest continuously in building and extending your knowledge and skills.

Your Background

  • Exceptional expertise in AI engineering, machine learning and data science.
  • Strong hands-on technical and coding skills are a strong advantage for this role.
  • 7 years of experience delivering and managing AI solutions through incubation, proofs-of-concept, to deployment and commercialisation.
  • Proven experience designing and deploying agentic AI systems — including multi-agent orchestration, tool-use, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and autonomous task execution frameworks (e.g. LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar).
  • Candidates should demonstrate strength in either AI Engineering or ML Engineering (see below). Strength in both is a plus.

Platform & Delivery

  • At least 5 years of implementation experience with serverless computing, CI/CD, containerisation, Infrastructure as Code, code version control and automated testing.
  • Broad experience of model deployment, canary releases and implementation on cloud.
  • Experience of automated data pipelines, data labelling, versioning and exploration.
  • Strong ability to develop and maintain relationships amongst clients, colleagues, and partners.
  • Ability to develop and deliver client proposals, and build consensus supported by detailed analysis, deep expertise and effective communication.
  • Demonstrated ability to guide, develop and mentor AI and data engineers.
  • Demonstrated ability to create technical blogs & thought leadership on AI.
  • Active engagement in the AI community taking and giving courses, following podcasts, reading books, attending meetups, and developing projects.
  • Familiarity with agentic coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor and Google Antigravity will be an advantage.

You should demonstrate strong proficiency in either AI Engineering or ML Engineering / MLOps. Proficiency in both is a significant advantage.

AI Engineering (LLM & Agentic Systems)

  • Practical hands-on experience with LLMs and agentic tooling: LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, OpenAI API, Anthropic API, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, Azure ML, Hugging Face Transformers, MLFlow, Dataiku, MS Fairlearn, Google PAIR.
  • Experience with prompt engineering, fine-tuning, evaluation frameworks, and responsible AI tooling.

ML Engineering / MLOps

  • Practical hands-on experience with ML development and deployment tooling: Jupyter, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-learn, AWS SageMaker, MLFlow, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible, Datadog.
  • Broad experience of NLP, computer vision, classification & recommendation systems, reinforcement learning and time series.
  • Experience designing and managing model experiment tracking and training workflows: hyperparameter tuning, cross-validation, experiment logging (e.g. MLFlow, Weights & Biases), and reproducible training runs.
  • Solid understanding and hands-on experience with the MLOps lifecycle: data versioning, model training pipelines, experiment tracking, model registry, deployment, monitoring, drift detection, and retraining triggers — using platforms such as MLFlow, Weights & Biases, Kubeflow, AWS SageMaker Pipelines, Azure ML Pipelines, or Google Vertex AI Pipelines.

Temus is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from all. We do not discriminate by race, religion, belief, ethnicity, origin, disability, age, partnership status, sexual orientation, or gender identity.

We see the diversity of our team as a strategic advantage, and we work actively to maintain it.

jobs.description_text:
Temus is a Temasek-backed consulting firm providing digital transformation solutions for the private and public sectors. We aspire to be a strategic partner in realising the Singapore Government’s Smart Nation vision. We are headquartered in Singapore and have more than 400 employees across a wide range of disciplines in strategy, design, architecture, technology, data & AI.

Our Purpose

  • Place client value and human experience at the centre of everything we do.
  • Leverage technology, AI and data to solve complex business challenges and deliver transformative outcomes.
  • Build trusted, scalable, and impactful digital solutions across public and private sectors.
  • Foster innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning across our teams.

Your Role

  • Partner closely with clients to understand business challenges and translate them into scalable technology solutions.
  • Design, build, and deploy production-grade applications that leverage AI, data, and cloud technologies to create measurable business value.
  • Work directly with client stakeholders, product teams, AI engineers, data scientists, and solution architects to deliver end-to-end solutions.
  • Rapidly prototype, iterate, and productionise solutions based on user feedback and evolving business requirements.
  • Serve as a trusted technical advisor, bridging business needs and technical implementation.
  • Invest continuously in building and extending your technical, consulting, and domain expertise.

Requirements

Software Engineering & Development

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals with experience building scalable, production-grade applications.
  • Proficiency in Python and modern backend frameworks such as FastAPI, Flask, Django, or Node.js.
  • Experience developing RESTful APIs, microservices, and cloud-native applications.
  • Familiarity with frontend technologies such as React, Angular, or Vue.js is advantageous.

Cloud & Platform Engineering

  • Experience deploying applications on AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
  • Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Helm, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Understanding of scalability, reliability, and distributed systems.

AI & Data Applications

  • Experience integrating AI, GenAI, or machine learning capabilities into business applications.
  • Familiarity with platforms such as OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Vertex AI, LangChain, or LangGraph is advantageous.
  • Ability to collaborate with AI Engineers and Data Scientists to productionise AI solutions.

Client Delivery & Consulting

  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to deliver solutions in ambiguous environments.
  • High ownership mindset with a track record of driving initiatives end-to-end.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills across technical and business audiences.
  • Ability to quickly understand client challenges and translate them into practical solutions.
  • Comfortable engaging clients directly.

Temus is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from all. We do not discriminate by race, religion, belief, ethnicity, origin, disability, age, partnership status, sexual orientation, or gender identity.

We see the diversity of our team as a strategic advantage, and we work actively to maintain it.

jobs.description_text:
Temus is a Temasek-backed consulting firm providing digital transformation solutions for the private and public sectors. We aspire to be a strategic partner in realising the Singapore Government’s Smart Nation vision. We are headquartered in Singapore and have more than 400 employees across a wide range of disciplines in strategy, design, architecture, technology, data & AI.

Your Role

  • Harness your expertise in full stack AI development and cloud engineering to design, build, and maintain end-to-end applications and the infrastructure they run on.
  • Make an outstanding contribution to a world-class engineering team.
  • Develop and maintain relationships with a broad range of clients, colleagues, and partners across a variety of contexts and formats.
  • Invest continuously in building and extending your knowledge and skills.

Your Background

  • At least 3–7 years of relevant working experience in software engineering, full stack development, or a related technical field.
  • Hands-on experience building and deploying production-grade full-stack applications, including AI/GenAI workloads.
  • Experience integrating LLMs, RAG, AI agents or agentic workflows into user-facing applications.
  • Proven track record in full stack fundamentals: at least one backend language (Java, Python, or similar), one modern JavaScript framework, API design, and relational data modelling.
  • Hands-on experience with a major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including compute, storage, networking, and IAM.
  • At least 3 years of implementation experience with CI/CD, containerisation, Infrastructure as Code, code version control and automated testing.
  • Experience working with transactional databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server).
  • Familiarity with AI/ML concepts and integrating AI services into applications.
  • Pro-active, curious personality with a strong desire to learn and grow.
  • Good English communication skills, ability to communicate with clients and stakeholders effectively.

Application Development

  • Hands-on experience building and running production web applications end to end.
  • Experience with frameworks such as Spring, Quarkus, FastAPI, Node.js, or React.
  • API design and integration, including REST, GraphQL, and messaging patterns.

Cloud & DevSecOps

  • DevOps practices including containerisation (Docker, Kubernetes), Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), and automated testing.
  • CI/CD pipeline design with GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or Jenkins, applying GitOps practices.
  • Secure-by-design practices across application and infrastructure layers, including identity and access management, secrets management, and least-privilege design.
  • Strong focus on code quality, system reliability, and observability (monitoring, logging, alerting).
  • Cloud certifications (e.g., AWS Solutions Architect, CKAD) are a plus.

Client Delivery & Support

  • Experience acting as a technical point of contact for system issues, coordinating with clients and operations teams.
  • Ability to produce technical and non-technical user documentation.
  • Experience with financial services or public sector clients is a plus.
